delegations.answer:
PARTIAL ANSWER: Based on my investigation, CloudTrail (`aws:cloudtrail`) does **not** contain any `PutObject`, `PostObject`, or `CompleteMultipartUpload` events for the `frothlywebcode` bucket. The only S3 write events in CloudTrail are two `PutBucketAcl` events:

1. **eventID:** `ab45689d-69cd-41e7-8705-5350402cf7ac` at `2018-08-20T13:01:46Z` — user `bstoll` from `107.77.212.175` — no errorCode (success)
2. **eventID:** `9a33d8df-1e16-4d58-b36d-8e80ce68f8a3` at `2018-08-20T13:57:54Z` — user `bstoll` from `107.77.212.175` — no errorCode (success)

However, the **S3 access logs** (`aws:s3:accesslogs`) DO contain `REST.PUT.OBJECT` events for `frothlywebcode`:

- **Successful upload:** At `2018-08-20T14:19:19Z`, user `bstoll` (arn:aws:iam::622676721278:user/bstoll) from IP `107.77.212.175` uploaded object key `frothly_html_memcached.tar.gz` via `REST.PUT.OBJECT` with HTTP status **200** (success). This was done via the S3 Console (browser: Chrome on Windows 10). Object size: 3,057,116 bytes.

- **Failed upload:** At `2018-08-20T14:15:05Z`, from IP `54.241.141.120` (no authenticated user), an attempt to PUT object key `%E2%80%98%E2%80%99frothly_html_memcached.tar.gz` (smart-quote prefixed filename) returned HTTP **403 AccessDenied**. User agent: `Boto3/1.7.64 Python/2.7.14`.

I did not find any **text file** (.txt) uploads — only `.tar.gz` files were observed. I was unable to complete a comprehensive search for all text file extensions due to tool call limits.

UNCERTAINTY:
- CloudTrail has no object-level write events (PutObject etc.) — only bucket-level ACL changes. S3 access logging captured the actual object uploads.
- I could not complete a full search for `.txt` file uploads across all S3 access log events for frothlywebcode. The two uploads I found were both `.tar.gz` files.
- The S3 access log field extraction may not have standard field names (the raw events are space-delimited), so my field-based aggregation query returned 0 results; I had to rely on raw event inspection.
